steps.name: What map (1)
steps.objective: First, talk to [Arke] at 「Pneuma」, and then visit [Yuran] at 「Lumen Union Headquarters」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer?
(Arke is surprised to see %s's face appearing in front of him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Secret… , no… . I thought you would come here again someday, but I didn't know you would come so soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just wanted to come. Once I visited a place, I ended up visiting it again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So how could I come... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Arche why he was able to come back to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I see. Iris said… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Were there any problems when you came? Symptoms like feeling like your whole body is being torn apart or like it's twisted and disappearing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, is it really that painful?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret... . yes.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When Gaia brought me here to save me, I was very sick.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But seeing as Adventurer was okay… . perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I guess it hurts less because I was loved by the goddesses!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After thinking about it for a long time, I found an answer... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehehe. I am like that.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, that's right. I'd like to ask you a favor, is it okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please find the item. This item came from the place where Adventurer was.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A while ago, when space and time were shaken, I think it flowed into this place. I was having a hard time trying to find it even though I was looking for it.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If the spirits come under a strange influence while searching for the item, it could cause confusion not only here but also to the place where the goddess is.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer, I want you to find this item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me help you. But what is that thing?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Right now, I don't know what type of object it is. So, Adventurer needs to find out who among the people he knows has lost what.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's complicated.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The moment Adventurer finds out, the object will emerge from the realm of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, where should I go first… ?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: First, go to Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lu Man?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Iris Since your mental world is nearby, I thought it might have flowed in from there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! Then I'll go and ask.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you, %s. As you find it, go to the area where Kronos is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First, I have to go to Yuran and ask him. Since he is the person who knows Luman best...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Are you here? It's been a while since I saw you. Thank you for helping Master. Thanks… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I have to do... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris You are saying the same thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, when did Iris come?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That's not the case, the message was conveyed through the flower spirit Zoe. As expected, %s is no different.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There's no need to visit Lu Man anymore, is there? There won't be anything for outsiders to do in Eastland anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You’re cool as usual….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not Eastland's business, it's personal.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: … Is this by any chance Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I say that, would you understand?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then I will cooperate. You tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, have you seen anyone looking for lost items on Luman recently?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's vague. It's a lost item... . ah. Wool might be looking for something. It's on that tree, so if you go there you'll be able to see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go to Ul right away. But is wool okay these days? You were very worried.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I think it's beyond my scope to worry. Whatever happens now, it will be Ul's responsibility. If Master calls me later, I will see you then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, see you later then.

steps.name: some maps (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Kronos] in 「Time of Kronos」 and obtain <Map of a Certain Continent>. Go to the dungeon reward room and check the situation, then report the quest to [Ul] at the “Luman Union Headquarters.”

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was no greeting.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I don't think it's time for us to say hello separately... . Don't make me ask again. Did your sister-in-law send you again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I wanted to ask you something. Have you lost or are looking for something recently?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Was that why I couldn't find it no matter how much I searched? Flowing into another world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to say it's my fault?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No. It must have been unavoidable. I don't think it's that bad.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So are you going to look for it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you tell me what it is, I think I can find it.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You have already reached that world.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Please, in that sense. Please find that item for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what were you looking for?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Maps of different continents. It was stored at the Federation Headquarters, but the moment I tried to find it, it disappeared in my hands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why were you watching that?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You don't need to know. Well then, come and visit us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that attitude... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: When people change, they die quickly. It will be less stressful to just go without making a fuss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . I get it. It has to be done anyway... .
(Adventurer, not expecting a change in attitude from Wool, leaves Lu Man, and something huge climbing a tree appears in front of Wool.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The appearance is loud.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: It can't be helped. My body size is like this... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Did you find the door?

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: All traces of the door leading from Eastland to the Demon World have disappeared.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Even if Weiss disappeared, it would be normal if traces of the demon world remained... ? It has nothing to do with Vice, but... .

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: Can I tell you what I think?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I think it's somewhat similar to my thoughts... .

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: Yes… . you're right. Someone from the demon world must have had a hand in it. Even so, Lux... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Ah, Beskar.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Let's check the map as soon as we receive it. Let’s go to the land of our ancestors you mentioned. Then you can do something, right?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Welcome, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Kronos. Were you waiting here?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I thought you were coming so I came to meet you. Did you hear what Arche said, boo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I figured out what I needed to look for.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What is that? hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard it's a map of a continent that Eastland people have never been to.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I see, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: That's it, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you holding off?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I felt like I had flowed into a deeper realm than the space I was originally in. There are conditions for you to go there. hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no way… Probably not... .

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What you think is ‘probably’ correct. hoot. You have to get 'permission' to deal with me, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I know what you're thinking, boo. That place was made of a will stronger than mine, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ancient God… ?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It may be so, or it may not be so. hoot.
(Kronos suddenly winks with a sullen expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Suddenly winking?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll wait in front of you, so take me down. hoot. Of course, it won't go down easily. hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Kronos.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: See you later then. %s.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Pour!
(Kronos roars and flies up into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if I hear that crying again, I can't get used to it. Phew, shall we come to our senses and go?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Ow… ?
(Kronos stops moving and steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kronos?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: ‘Permission’ was given to your will to deal with me. hoot. You can take things with you. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Squat down on the floor and take a look. hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it really okay?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I have a lot of doubts, boo. Would you like me to recite a spell for you, boo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoosh whoosh, what is this?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: That's similar, but how did you know, boo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All spirits are similar. The order is okay. ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm holding something in my hand. This is it!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: This is exactly what you are looking for. hoot. Can I take a look, boo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: While I'm already holding it... . Well, do you have anything to check?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I want to know what continent it is, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Let’s see, let’s see… . hmm. Here is Giendia, here is Freios, here is Crete, now Eastland. Swell.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: There are a few more continents, but I have no idea. Because it is a place beyond the power of the Goddess, no information is coming in. hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… .

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Someday, God's messenger will have to go and check the information, right?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: My area was a little chaotic, but it seems to have regained stability. Is there one left now? hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what else there is, but I think I'll have to bring the stuff and come back to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Then you will meet Kairos, boo. Now there are no external objects in this space, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Kronos. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It was nice to meet you, boo. Then I have to go to work too. hoot.
(As Kronos leaves his seat and flies away, his lonely words are carried by the wind.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스의 목소리
lines.text: I want to take a vacation. hoot… . I want to sleep like Kairos. hoot… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … The work must be hard. Ah, this is not the time to be like this. Let's go to Wool.
(Ul looks at the map in %s's hand and laughs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, the map.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I won't be surprised again. This isn't the first time you've done that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I looked at it on the way, and there are other continents on this map, right?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yeah. what. Gendia, Freios, Eastland... . And a few other continents.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I believe the names that have been handed down are Teiges, Nagen, and Otros, but I don't know if that's correct or not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing as there is no information from Kronos... shall we hear more about the story?)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The continent we interact with is Freios. Okay, go now. Even if you pry like that, I won't have an answer for you.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It's surprising.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Actually, I don't know anything either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Goodbye then. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Thank you. I don't know if I'll ever see you again, but if I do, please take care of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh, what is it? It’s a lot different than before… Where are you going?)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing. Yeah, yeah... . I have somewhere to go again, so I'm going now.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Phew... First of all, now that I've found one, I'll have to ask Arche where to go next.)
(As %s's figure moves away, Wool stretches lightly.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'm so upset today.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Now we have to get ready. Before I go, I have to apologize to Sister Elle for my mistake. It feels a bit uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ugh, what did you say just now?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Why is Sister El here? .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The first sister-in-law told me to call you. What mistake did I make?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I can't tell you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: If you tell me, I will forgive you right away.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Sis, I stepped on it by mistake.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I can't hear you, what?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Sister El stepped on the paper dragon. Now, wait a minute. El Sister… .
(L, who already looks cold, looks at Wool with a stern expression.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Beskar, is it nearby? Catch this guy!!

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Beskar! I am your master. Listen to me!! Uh, first sister-in-law… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The troublesome youngest ones are as feisty as expected, right? You made Master and me wait for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master went first, saying he had work to do. Please tell your teacher separately later.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It can't be helped that I came late, so I won't worry about it. By the way, when did I deal with those two? .
(Yu-ran shows Ul and L a bright smile that has rarely been seen. However, as the smile deepens, the two people who see it only feel fear in the smile.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: … Sister-in-law, just that... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yes, I was wrong.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: What did you guys do wrong? I just want to see the youngest members' skills after a long time.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll bring the sword soon, so don't go anywhere and just wait. You know what happens if you disappoint me, right?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yes… .

(According to the story told later, under Yuran's orders, entry and training to the Floating Island, the Poisonous Fog Swamp of Illusion, and the Forest of Water Lily were prohibited for a time except for those involved.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Sister, I will be waiting here.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You too, follow me.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes?!
